thread:
Alex: Quick sync — we need a tight PRD + rollout/experiment plan for the model-routing version-pinning work requested by AcmeCorp. Key asks: pin sessions to model versions, canary routing for new model variants, clear rollback criteria and acceptance metrics.

Rita: Ack. To scope: are we building pinning as a runtime knob (per-session) or a pre-deploy routing table? Each has different complexity.

Alex: runtime knob preferred (customer wants per-tenant pin). But open to engineering constraints. Also need to support canary split percentages and fallback to compatible variant.

Maria: FYI AcmeCorp cares about: 1) deterministic pinning for compliance, 2) zero-latency regressions >5% on p95, 3) ability to quickly unpin. They'll sign off only if there's an audit trail.

Rita: Understood. Engineering questions: how many concurrent pinned versions? do we limit to N=2 per tenant? Also runtime impacts: maintaining multiple KV caches if model architectures differ.

Linh: For A/B/canary metrics I propose: primary metric = p95 latency; secondary = token error rate (server errors / 1k requests); guardrail = hallucination proxy (QA evals on sample prompts). Stats thresholds: use Bayesian bandit for early stopping OR require 95% credible interval that new variant is non-inferior with delta=+5% latency.

Sam: Runbook/rollback: define automated rollback if error_rate increase >0.2% absolute OR p95 latency regression >10% for 5m rolling. Also manual cancel if customer requests. I'll draft playbook and include pager rules. Tagging: deploy-bot will post canary start/stop events.

Alex: Good. Can someone sketch PRD sections? I'll take draft of Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Timeline. Rita add Deployment/Config examples. Linh provide experiment matrix and analysis queries. Sam produce runbook + monitoring alerts. Maria gather customer's acceptance checklist.

Rita: I'll put a sample config in the PRD. Example:
```
canary:
  percentage: 5
  duration_minutes: 60
  rollback_triggers:
    - p95_latency_increase_pct: 10
    - error_rate_increase_abs: 0.002
pinning:
  per_tenant: true
  max_active_pins: 2
  audit_log: true
```

Alex: Timeline: PRD draft by Fri EOD (1749610000), internal review Mon, canary infra ready by next sprint. Owners: Alex (PRD), Rita (infra/deploy), Linh (experiments), Sam (runbook), Maria (customer acceptance). Please update thread when you add your section. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: canary started for tenant=acmecorp variant=v2 at 1749454000

Rita: Noted. I'll upload an initial PRD doc link later today.

Linh: I'll prepare analysis DAG and example SQL for experiment results.

Sam: I'll wire alerting and automate a rollback API call. Drafting now.

Maria: I'll send AcmeCorp the proposed acceptance criteria for sign-off.

Alex: Thanks all — we'll sync 30m on Friday if needed. Keep updates in this thread.
